mapper.select: SELECT a.asgn_id AS "id", a.proj_id AS "projectId", a.dev_id AS "developerId", a.job_cd AS "jobCode", a.input_bgn_dt AS "startDate", a.input_end_dt AS "endDate", a.ctrt_mm AS "contractMm", a.bill_uprc AS "price", a.input_type_cd AS "inputType", a.ctrt_dev_id AS "contractDeveloperId", a.ext_psbl_cd AS "extensionPossibility", a.ext_cnt::int AS "extensionCount", a.early_wthdr_yn AS "earlyWithdrawal", a.asgn_stat_cd AS "status" FROM tb_pj_asgn a JOIN tb_hr_dev d ON d.dev_id = a.dev_id ORDER BY a.asgn_id
